parties.respondent: Syed Mohd. Ahmad Ali Khan AND OTHERS

summary: Waqf property recovery dispute; compromise invalid without Waqf Board sanction under Section 49A UP Muslim Waqf Act; Controller's Order under Section 52 Waqf Act invalid due to procedural irregularities; adverse possession established against beneficiaries; Section 52(1) inquiry not properly conducted; special statutes no bar to adverse possession; title vests in respondents.
legal_provisions_cited: UP Muslim Waqf Act, 1960 s.49A, s.69
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment sustaining adverse possession and invalidating Controller's Order upheld.
